works.author: Nizam
works.comment: 深色高密度数据界面配 AI 洞察卡片，收入智能类产品的版式密度与信息层级值得抄。
works.comment_en: Dark, high-density data UI with AI insight cards — the layout density and hierarchy are worth stealing for revenue-intelligence products.
works.title: Vero — AI-Powered Revenue Intelligence Product

works.author: AmazingUI
works.comment: 动效驱动的 agent 交互概念，球形可视化表达适合 AI 产品概念包装。
works.comment_en: A motion-driven agent interaction concept; the spherical visualization is great for packaging AI product concepts.
works.title: Orb - Agentic OS by AmazingUI

works.author: Purrweb Web Design
works.comment: 产品数据管理后台，表格/筛选/批量操作的信息架构干净，B2B 后台可借鉴。
works.comment_en: Product-data management admin: clean IA across tables, filters, and bulk actions — worth borrowing for B2B back offices.
works.title: PIM Software Dashboard UI Design

works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 生鲜电商 App，商品卡片与分类浏览的移动端动线流畅，品类电商可参考。

works.comment: 血糖监测健康 App，数据可视化配柔和配色，图表与空状态处理细腻。
